bullets.text: AI Dominates MWC 2026 - Expect AI to frame discussions, especially in RAN operations and next-gen investment cycles.
Ookla's 5G Slice Validation - New methodology allows performance monitoring of individual 5G network slices for better service assurance.
T-Mobile US Leads AI-Native Shift - Strategic partnerships aim to accelerate the transition from 5G to AI-native 6G technologies.
ZTE's AIR MAX Revolution - New mobile network solution optimizes energy, labor, and investment efficiency for AI integration.
Huawei's AI-Centric Solutions - Enhanced network solutions aim to unlock 5G-A potential and prepare for seamless 6G transition.
TalkTalk Business Goes Independent - Formal separation from TalkTalk Group enhances operational autonomy and growth potential.
O2 Satellite Service Launched - Virgin Media O2 introduces satellite-to-mobile service to enhance connectivity in rural areas.
Vodafone Calls for Satellite Standards - Emphasis on safety and security rules for integrating satellite services with terrestrial networks.
Deutsche Telekom's AI Integration - AI agents optimize mobile capacity and enhance enterprise infrastructure at scale.
Cloud RAN Trial Success - AI boosts network efficiency, proving its potential for better resource management in telecoms.
